title: $87.5 Million Awarded for Bridge Replacement on West Virginia-Ohio Border
description: The West Virginia Division of Highways (WVDOH) has been awarded $87.5 million through the Bridge Investment Program to fully replace the deteriorating Market Street Bridge and reopen a major thoroughfare that connects Ohio and West Virginia. Built in 1905, this almost 120-year-old structure was added to the National Register of Historic Places in 2019, and has sat in limbo for nearly seven months after its closure in December 2023 due to continuing structural issues. The bridge links West Virginia Route 2 with Ohio Route 7 and acts as a traffic reliever for its northern neighbor, the Veterans Memorial Bridge, which carries U.S. Route 22 across the Ohio River. This is a major win for both the WVDOH and the Ohio Department of Transportation, which worked together to secure funding for the replacement. The project is expected to be completed within the next 10 years and will provide a critical connection between communities in West Virginia and Ohio.

title: U.S. Department of Energy Awards $9.8 million for Iron Phosphate Manufacturing in Bridgeport, WV
description:
Sparkz Inc. received a $9.8 million award from the U.S. Department of Energy to redevelop a closed manufacturing facility in Bridgeport, WV into a first-of-its-kind battery-grade iron phosphate (FePO4) plant. This is one of 14 projects selected from coal communities across the nation to receive funding to address energy supply chain vulnerabilities and accelerate domestic clean energy manufacturing.

Iron Phosphate is a precursor material for the manufacture of Lithium Iron Phosphate (LFP) lithium-ion batteries for electric vehicles and is not currently manufactured in the U.S. In addition to establishing a domestic supply chain for LFP production, this award will directly benefit the community of Bridgeport and the greater Taylor County area by creating 75 high quality jobs. Sparkz is working with the United Mine Workers of America Labor Union and the West Virginia Economic Development Authority to recruit, hire, and train members of the local community.
